title: Geschichteter Kalkfindling A
description: Länglicher zusammenhängender Kalkfindling mit geneigten Schichtbänken, zurückgesetzten dunklen Lagerfugen und schräg abgebrochener Oberseite. Modellierte feine Laminationen, stufige Abplatzungen und gezackte Sackklüfte mit eingeklemmtem Geröll. Helle kreidige lokale Variante von canyon_layered für Canyonränder und lichte Hänge.

review.notes: Round 1. Close. It is the right idea for STYLE.md 'Felsen': modelled horizontal chalk beds cut by long vertical clefts, a broken sloping top with a corner notch, light fracture faces with darker joints, and the 7.8 m scale reads well beside the figure (hero.jpg, closeup.jpg). Defects: (1) style/defects: the two lowest beds are flat stepped plinths with long straight chamfered edges and regular polygon outlines (closeup_base, turn_155/245/290), so the foot reads as a cut pedestal and not as rock. Break the foot beds with irregular outlines, undercut and partly buried edges, a few fallen blocks and soil or grass contact, so the boulder sits in the ground instead of on a base. (2) The beds above are nearly the same thickness and stack like a layered cake. Vary them (for example 0.4 / 1.2 / 0.7 / 1.6 m), let one or two pinch out or overhang, and offset the clefts between beds. (3) material: a uniform dark dash/scratch pattern covers every face at the same scale (closeup_base). Keep it only as fine detail in the joints and under ledges, and let the large fracture faces stay calm and lighter, per 'Große helle Bruchflächen'.
